args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST

Essential Items:
- Passport/ID
- Travel documents (reservations, tickets)
- Sunglasses and sun hat
- Sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- Reusable water bottle
- Beach towel
- Beach bag

Clothing:
- Light, breathable clothing (t-shirts, shorts, sundresses)
- Swimwear (2-3 sets)
- Cover-ups
- Light jacket or cardigan (for air-conditioned spaces)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals
- Underwear and socks
- Pajamas

Beach & Water Activities:
- Snorkel mask and fins
- Beach umbrella or portable shade
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach toys (if traveling with kids)
- Inflatable floaties (optional)
- Water shoes (for rocky areas)

Health & Safety:
- First aid kit
- Motion sickness medication
- Pain relievers
- Allergy medication
- Hand sanitizer
- Wet wipes
- Deodorant
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Hairbrush/comb
- Basic toiletries

Electronics:
- Camera and extra batteries
- Phone charger and power bank
- Portable speaker
- Universal travel adapter
- Headphones

Miscellaneous:
- Cash and credit cards
- Small backpack for day trips
- Travel pillow
- Eye mask and earplugs
- Travel umbrella
- Ziploc bags (various sizes)
- Laundry detergent sheets
- Laundry bag

Hawaii-Specific Items:
- Reef-safe sunscreen
- Biodegradable soap
- Insect repellent
- Hawaii state park pass (if needed)
- Local SIM card or international roaming plan

Remember to pack light and leave room for souvenirs!
